event.title: The Massive AI Manual: Launch Night
event.tagline: AI, explained by a friend — come ask anything.
event.description:
Celebrating the release of The Massive AI Manual, the beginner-friendly guide that explains AI like a friend would: plain English, step by step, never condescending.
Dylan reads a short excerpt, walks through two live demos (no slides, promise), and answers every question — including the ones you think are too basic. They never are.
Signed copies will be available.

where.getting_there: Free lot behind the store; the #12 bus stops at the corner.

capacity_note: Seats are limited to 40 — first come, first reserved.
cost: Free · signed copies of the book available ($24)
accessibility_notes: Step-free entrance with an automatic door; the greeter can help.
Reserved seating up front for anyone who asks.
Live captions on the big screen during the demos.
A quiet corner in the back with lower lighting if you need a break.
Service animals welcome; water bowls provided.
Welcome to bring fidget tools, headphones, or a support person.

waiting_list.note: The room holds 40 and our last launch filled up in ten days. If RSVPs are closed, email us anyway — we seat the waiting list in order, and no-shows free up seats each time.
